subject: Project supervision meeting agenda
body: Hello, the agenda for our scheduled supervision meeting is attached in the course workspace. We will discuss progress, risks, and next steps. Thank you.

subject: Library book return confirmation
body: This confirms that your library book was returned today. No action is required. Your account now shows no items on loan.

subject: Weekly development update
body: The local API tests now pass and the extension popup has been connected. The next task is to record the evaluation metrics in the project log.

subject: Receipt for campus printing
body: Your campus printing balance was charged 2.50 GBP. This is an automated receipt for your records and no response is needed.

subject: Room change for Thursday lecture
body: Thursday's lecture will take place in room 2B14 instead of 2B10. The start time remains 10:00.

subject: Report feedback available
body: Feedback on your submitted draft is now available through the usual university learning platform. Please review it before the next meeting.

subject: Urgent: account access expires today
body: Your mailbox will be disabled today. Click https://account-check.example.invalid immediately and enter your password to verify your account.

subject: Invoice payment overdue
body: Final warning. The attached invoice is overdue. Send payment by wire transfer within 24 hours to avoid a penalty.

subject: Unexpected tax refund
body: A refund is waiting. Click the link at https://refund.example.invalid and provide your bank and card details to receive it now.

subject: Security alert: unauthorised access
body: We detected unauthorised access. Sign in immediately at https://security-review.example.invalid or your account will be locked.

subject: Gift card request from management
body: I am in a meeting and need you to act now. Buy gift cards and reply with the codes. Keep this urgent request confidential.

subject: Password reset required
body: Your password expires today. Verify your credentials using www.reset-access.example.invalid to prevent the account from being closed.
